thesis: The page is the triple-decker read from the sidewalk: three stacked floor bands, each one a porch level, and scrolling walks up the house.

signature.name: Floor Band + Baluster Rule
signature.summary: Each section is a floor band topped by a repeating baluster-pattern SVG rule; a fixed triple-decker elevation drawing in the corner lights the active floor on scroll. Hook: data-sw-signature='floor-band'.

motion.intro: Hero letters fill bottom-up like porch lights switching on (clip-path inset on text-mask bg); skippable, ≤1.2s.
stories: Pinned triple-decker SVG elevation builds porches floor-by-floor via DrawSVG (640px+); under 640px static.
Each floor band's baluster rule draws left-to-right via clip-path wipe on entry.
motion.hover: Hairline teal underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1) on links and buttons.
